metadata.name: toolbtn
metadata.description: (glyph, title, handler, payload?) - a generic toolbar/titlebar button for any windowed app: shows `glyph`, stops pointerdown (so it doesn't start a window drag), and dispatches handler(state, payload, event) on click. Compose several inside toolbar().

metadata.name: toolbar
metadata.description: (...children) - a horizontal toolbar row an app places above its content. Arrays flatten and non-vnodes drop, so MAP(...) of toolbtn()s works. App-agnostic chrome; sheet-specific UI lives in the sheets segment.

metadata.name: app.install
metadata.description: (manifest) - install an app's ASSETS to OPFS from an assets manifest { name, version, readme?, assets:[{url, opfs, sha?}] } (object or a URL to its JSON). Downloads each MISSING asset to its opfs path (idempotent), verifying SHA-256 when given. Returns a one-line status. The foundation for origin-applications defined in formula-cels: install to OPFS, then load from OPFS into state. Network + OPFS IO.

metadata.name: app.installed
metadata.description: (manifest) - true iff every asset in the manifest is already present in OPFS (a formula can branch on it: install when false, load when true).
